title: Tencent’s Gander targets the gap between talking and doing
teaser: Tencent’s Hunyuan Speech team and researchers from several universities have introduced Gander, a multimodal AI model designed to keep talking while another system works in the background. It processes speech, images and text continuously, including during its own replies, so a user can interrupt it at any moment. That targets a basic weakness in today’s voice assistants: they usually take turns, while real conversations involve interruptions, quick reactions and updates while a longer task is still running.
